material.title: Acme launches the Atlas, an 800V electric SUV
material.bodyOriginal: Acme today launched the Atlas, an 800V electric SUV with a 700 km CLTC range, priced from ¥199,800. Deliveries begin in November, and the battery specification sheet is available.

material.title: 十大理由告诉你为什么今年必须换电车
material.bodyZh: 新能源车已经成为趋势。下面十条理由告诉你为什么今年该换一辆电动车，从用车成本到智能座舱。报名我们的团购活动了解更多，本月下定还送充电桩。
